**Professional Background**

Laikin has been active in the commercial real estate industry for over 45 years.[2] His career progression includes:
- **1980-1990**: Worked with Blackmore & Associates Commercial Real Estate
- **1990-January 2025**: Founding shareholder in the Los Angeles-Long Beach office of Lee & Associates
